g.title: J_OBC_RF
g.text: OBC board: PD5, PD6, PE3, PE4, PA0, PC0, PC1; three readback inputs (pins 8-10) to be allocated by the OBC designer (RID RF-21 / AV-05)

g.title: W4A
g.text: 3.3 V logic both ends (RF side 3.1 V CMOS, 1 k series on the readbacks). Monitors 0-2.5 V into ADC1. TX_PWR_SEL low 0.5 W, high 1 W. XPDR_EN: 100 Hz heartbeat, 100 k pull-down on the RF board

g.title: J_EPS_RF
g.text: EPS board: SW2 RADIO, SW3 PA outputs

g.title: W4B
g.text: RADIO rail 3.3 V: 31 mA typ, 38 mA worst receiving, +51 mA while keyed (exciter). PA rail 5 V: 0.35 A at 0.5 W RF, 0.47 A at 1 W, two contacts
